title: Industrial Design Intern [Summer 2027]
note: Needs at least two years of transportation/product design coursework and one prior internship or relevant project; must return to school after.

facts.summary: 12-week industrial design internship on Zoox's robotaxi design team; housing stipend and relocation help may be offered.
facts.duties: Develop design themes for vehicles and hardware products on a tailored project, build a repeatable design process, and work with designers, surface modelers and engineers.
facts.requirements: Enrolled in a BS/MS in transportation, industrial or product design; 2+ years of design coursework; a prior internship, co-op or relevant project; portfolio; strong sketching; basic 3D (Alias, Blender).
